Volcano observatory weekly update. Volcanic tremor continued beneath the summit throughout the week, at a level similar to the previous week. Gas emissions were measured twice and stayed within the normal range. A small ash plume rose briefly on Tuesday and drifted north before dispersing. No lava was seen at the surface. The alert level remains at advisory. Field crews serviced two monitoring stations on the east flank. Webcam images were clear on four of seven days. The observatory reminds visitors to stay on marked trails and to check the advisory page before travelling. The next update will be issued next Friday unless activity changes. Staff also gave a talk at the local school about how tremor is recorded and what it can and cannot tell scientists. A grant was received to replace an aging seismometer next year.
